title: VeloraOS 1.10.25 - Web Intelligence Performance Hotfix
releaseNotes: Makes Web Auto and Web On faster by enriching only the strongest web results and fetching those pages concurrently.
Reduces page-fetch timeout to four seconds and keeps compact search snippets for every cited source.
Bounds web evidence to a smaller context so Qwen3 4B and 8B reach their final answer more reliably.
Fixes web-assisted chats that could save an empty assistant response while still displaying source cards.
Retries empty Qwen3 responses with an explicit final-answer pass and disables thinking where supported.
Guarantees a visible source-based fallback response if the local model still returns no final text.
Preserves Web Auto, Web On, Web Off, citations, privacy safeguards and SSRF protection.
